subject: Action plan kickoff — Private/VPC eval & deployment owners
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Alice Romero <alice.romero@beaconhealth.com>, infra@beaconhealth.com
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Action plan kickoff — Private/VPC eval & deployment owners

Hi Alice + Beacon team —

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we discussed, I’m kicking off a short action plan to get Beacon from evaluation to a private/VPC proof-of-concept (POC) that covers network connectivity, IAM/KMS controls, and deployment topology validation. Goal: sign the POC statement of work (SOW) and complete the security checklist within 4 weeks so you can validate throughput and latency in your environment.

I’ve attached a first-pass action plan (RDW_ActionPlan_v1.xlsx) that breaks the work into three streams: network & VPN, identity & key management, and runtime topology (single-tenant vs shared infra). Please review and comment.

Initial asks / owners I propose:
- Networking/VPN: Beacon infra (infra@beaconhealth.com) + Sam Greene (CloudConsults) — responsible for VPN config and firewall rules
- IAM/KMS & compliance evidence: Beacon security (security@beaconhealth.com) + Kimberly Park (Redwood) — coordinate KMS key options and SOC2 evidence mapping
- Deployment topology & perf: Diego Fernandez (Redwood) + Marcus Lin — run topology tests and sequence of model variants

Can you confirm the owners on your side and any blackout windows next two weeks? I’ll schedule a 30-minute kickoff this Wednesday to align on milestones.

Attachments: RDW_ActionPlan_v1.xlsx, Beacon_Network_Diagram_v0.1.pdf

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alice Romero <alice.romero@beaconhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: infra@beaconhealth.com, security@beaconhealth.com, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 18:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Action plan kickoff — Private/VPC eval & deployment owners

Thanks Marcus —

Appreciate the clear breakdown. Confirming owners on our side:
- Networking/VPN: I’m looping infra@beaconhealth.com (Nathan Patel) as the primary and Sam Greene from CloudConsults will provide implementation support.
- IAM/KMS & compliance: security@beaconhealth.com (Lina Park) will own KMS and evidence gathering.
- Deployment topology: I’ll be the business lead; Lina and Nathan will be the technical leads.

We’re generally available for a Wednesday afternoon kickoff — Wed Aug 5, 14:00 PT works. No major maintenance windows next two weeks.

I reviewed the action plan and left two inline comments on the diagram about subnet CIDR sizing. We’ll upload our current network diagram and some firewall templates before the call.

— Alice
Alice Romero
Director of Product Integrations, Beacon Health
alice.romero@beaconhealth.com

Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:06:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Action plan kickoff — Private/VPC eval & deployment owners

Thanks all — jumping in with proposed kickoff agenda and one clarification:

Proposed 30-min agenda (Wed Aug 5, 14:00 PT):
1) Introductions & roles (5m)
2) Review action plan milestones & acceptance criteria (10m)
3) Network connectivity requirements & sample firewall rules (7m)
4) IAM/KMS options and evidence list for SOC2 (5m)
5) Next steps & owners + confirm SOW timeline (3m)

Clarification: for KMS we support both customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) and Redwood-managed KMS; Lina, please confirm whether Beacon will require a BYOK flow and which KMS provider you prefer (AWS KMS vs Azure Key Vault). Kimberly will prepare the evidence checklist (SOC2 mapping) and attach it to the action plan after the call.

I’ll bring the deployment topology runbook and an initial test plan: sequence of models to run, target latency bands, and KV cache sizing. We’ll also propose a short performance smoke test (100 concurrent connections, 1k-token median sequence) to validate baseline.

Attachments to prep before call: Beacon_Network_Diagram_v0.1.pdf (Alice), SOC2_evidence_list.xlsx (Redwood draft).

— Diego
Diego Fernandez
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

> Initial action plan attached — please review and confirm owners.
From: Lina Park <security@beaconhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Alice Romero <alice.romero@beaconhealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, infra@beaconhealth.com, sam.greene@cloudconsults.io
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Action plan kickoff — Private/VPC eval & deployment owners

Thanks everyone — confirmed BYOK required; we will use our AWS KMS account and provide access as a cross-account role. Two quick asks before the kickoff:

1) Could Redwood share a short doc on the expected KMS key policy and the minimum IAM permissions you will need? We want to draft our security change request in advance.
2) For the network test, can you confirm whether the smoke test will traverse our existing firewall rules or whether we should open a temporary test subnet?

We’ll upload the final network diagram and a short list of blocked ports to the shared drive before the call. We prefer the kickoff time Marcus suggested.

Lina Park
Head of Security, Beacon Health
security@beaconhealth.com
